arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: the sides that brought the case argue the Eighth Circuit decision is an outlier. They say it conflicts with Section 1367 text. They say it conflicts with structure.
the opposing sides argue experience should guide the test. They say the law creating the claim controls. They say this test is definitive.
the sides that brought the case say ruling for the opposing sides requires overruling precedent. They list several cases that support their view. They say the opposing sides lose under experience.
the opposing sides say they would win without Section 1367. They say the issue was not squarely presented before. They say party presentation rules matter.
